concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-payment-methods-manage-payment-methods-customer-area]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace merchant-account Customer Area guide for configured-method list/details, activation, country/region edits and conditional inactive-unused 90-day deletion; currency change routes to Support.
warnings: This Customer Area page says methods that are both inactive and unused for 90 days are deleted (raw line 56), unlike the related API page's shorter disabled-method wording.
Intro mentions currency updates, but detailed UI steps only cover country/region and the requirements direct nondefault currency changes to Support (raw lines 24, 37, 58–69).
